message: A Metalama repository configuration file (metalama.json) has been ignored. {0}
title: A repository configuration file (metalama.json) has been ignored.
rationale: 'Not fully applied' suggests a partial application, but every warning produced by RepositoryConfigurationService (a metalama.json below the repository root, or a root file that cannot be read or deserialized) means that a whole file is ignored. The placeholder {0} is a complete sentence that starts with a capital letter, so it follows a period rather than a colon.
